messages:
alex: quick callout 7 we need a crisp launch plan for the Optimize toolkit (batching, caching, quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts). propose we pick a primary launch topology and clear M1 gates.
jamie: agree. my vote is two lanes: core (opinionated defaults, broad beta) and pilot (customer-tailored, guarded). keeps ops surface manageable.
ravi: two lanes sounds right. key M1s for core: econ_delta_pct >= 2, p50 latency change <= 10%, no critical errors in 48h, and eval-alert precision >= 0.65.
ops-bot: noted. will create alert labels `opt_lane=core|pilot` and route accordingly.
jamie: pilot lane requirements: opt-in only, eval sample >= 5k, concordance >= 0.7, audit logs on for enterprise customers.
tess: timeline suggestion: core beta in Q2 (self-serve), pilot onboarding Q3 with 2-3 customers. runtime team needs runway: ~2 sprints for batching/caching defaults + 1 sprint for quant canary. call that out in spec.
alex: good. we also need a machine-readable gate snippet to drop into infra. example: { lane: core, eval_min: 2000, precision: 0.65, stability_hours: 72, rollback_cost_pct: 5 }. (devs: treat as pseudo-yaml, not literal object).
ravi: add concordance check and a customer-facing opt-in flag. also define rollback triggers: cost_increase_pct > 5 OR user_quality_reports > 3x baseline -> immediate rollback.
jamie: eval-triggered alerts should be opt-in for pilot, opt-out for trial customers on core. provide UI toggle + API flag.
ops-bot: will also create Prometheus metrics: `optimize_alerts_fired_total` and `optimize_rollbacks_total` with lane label.
tess: docs acceptance: list lanes, M1 gates, pilot criteria, runtime effort, ops budget estimate, and rollback policy. alex, will you own the one-pager?
alex: i will. i'll draft and tag for review by EOD tomorrow. react with :white_check_mark: if you agree with the two-lane approach.
jamie: :white_check_mark:
ravi: :white_check_mark: (pending quant profiling time)
tess: :white_check_mark: (add ops budget note)
ops-bot: recorded reaction events. alex: ping when draft is up and i'll link the alert routing PR.
__notes: No title field. Thread contains a chronological Slack-style discussion about lanes, M1 gates, gating config, pilots, runtime effort, and rollback triggers for Optimize toolkit features (batching, caching, quantization recommendations, eval-triggered alerts).
